name: 77-opencost-read-proxy
command:
source /home/ubuntu/qa-week1/ingest.env
cd /home/ubuntu/qa-week1
kubectl apply -f curriculum/examples/telemetry/ingest-gateway.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deployment/kof-ingest-gateway -n kof
sed "s/INGEST_HOST/$INGEST_HOST/g" curriculum/examples/telemetry/opencost-query-proxy.yaml | kubectl --kubeconfig "$WORKLOAD_KUBECONFIG" apply -f -
kubectl --kubeconfig "$WORKLOAD_KUBECONFIG" rollout status deployment/kof-query-proxy -n kof --timeout=180s
stdout:
configmap/kof-ingest-gateway configured
deployment.apps/kof-ingest-gateway unchanged
service/kof-ingest-gateway unchanged
deployment.apps/kof-ingest-gateway restarted
configmap/kof-query-proxy created
deployment.apps/kof-query-proxy created
service/kof-query-proxy created
Waiting for deployment "kof-query-proxy" rollout to finish: 0 of 1 updated replicas are available...
deployment "kof-query-proxy" successfully rolled out
